parsed.rationale: Both `QualityTrend` (line 191) and `ThermalDirection` (line 208) are `type-alias-union` declarations in `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Throttling/QualitySignal.swift` with `shared_field_count: 3`, indicating they union over the same three underlying cases. However, they encode distinct domain concepts within the throttling subsystem: one models the trend of a quality signal, the other models the direction of a thermal reading. Collapsing them into a single shared type alias would conflate quality-signal semantics with thermal semantics, harming readability and type safety at call sites. The structural coincidence is incidental — both happen to be three-way directional enumerations — not evidence of true duplication.
